The three representative path failures passed with TMPDIR=/private/tmp; the hook file passed as a detached process with that canonical TMPDIR (37 pass, 4 skip). This is not a full-suite green claim.

Final full npm test passed: 476 files, 8983 passed, 0 failed, 82 skipped. Build, runtime build, native-agent/plugin/capabilities/prompt checks, catalog and prompt inventory checks all passed. Earlier long-running attempts overlapped macOS system sleep; final run used caffeinate.

limits: No automatic remote skill installation, trust, or update.
CLI discovery uses pinned external npm package in disposable HOME on explicit request; requires network/npm.
Skills.sh API needs Vercel OIDC; without it the adapter provides a search-page fallback.
Project skill evaluation runs configured checks in isolated copies with scrubbed environment, not an OS sandbox.
The independent live case proves fixture behavior, not general skill quality or token savings.
Generated skill hashes are checked at plan creation and before dispatch; concurrent manual edits during execution are outside this phase.
No remote GitHub fork, push, global OMX install or shared Codex setting change is part of this phase.
